material_findings: Public CPO trainer persistently retains dense bool masks, float32 protected references and int64 flat indices; logical persistent auxiliary tensor payload is N + 12uN bytes for mask-domain scalar count N and accumulated support fraction u.

Whole-model/full-mask-domain independent-support scenarios imply about 17.96 GiB 8B auxiliary payload after one 10% mask and 41.86 GiB after four independent masks; these are scenario calculations, not measured actual memory.
Release retains successive cumulative mask files; the same 8B scenario totals about 62.21 GiB logical tensor payload across four mask files.

Mask builder keeps current state dict live while loading previous model/state dict, allowing two full BF16 model-weight payloads to coexist; about 32.66 GiB for the public 8B weight size before other/transient memory.
Reference-weight refresh to the immediately previous checkpoint is consistent with the paper practical objective and is not a new discrepancy.
scope_guards: No actual CPO mask-domain coverage, support overlap, RSS, task_k.pt file size, H2D traffic or runtime was measured in this invocation.
Full-model numerical values are whole-mask-domain scenarios, not claims that every scalar is actually masked-domain eligible in a real run.
Independent task-support overlap is a scenario, not observed overlap.
Prior ZeRO-3 1/world_size result remains source-level algebra rather than a live eight-GPU reproduction or proof about unreleased paper-table code.
